question: What is the 'hidden side' of digital payments, according to the passage?
options: People may spend more without noticing

group.title: Reading comprehension
group.setup: Digital payments have made it easy to pay for a cup of tea with a phone, but this convenience has a hidden side. When people pay with cash, they see the money leave their hands, and many feel the cost more sharply. With a quick tap, the sense of spending fades, and small purchases add up without being noticed. Some families now set a weekly limit in their payment app or check their transaction history every Sunday. Such habits do not reject technology; they simply bring back the awareness that cash once gave naturally.
